channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Retailer TFG London hit by cyber-attack, customer data potentially exposed
item.description: TFG London, the owner of fashion brands Hobbs, Phase Eight, and Whistles, has reported a cybersecurity incident affecting its websites and IT systems. The company stated on Sunday that the attack may have compromised customers' personal… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Jury selection begins in Buffalo supermarket shooting hate crimes trial
item.description: Jury selection commenced Tuesday for the federal hate crimes trial of the gunman who killed 10 people at a supermarket in Buffalo, New York, in 2022. The trial could result in the white supremacist receiving the death penalty. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 0 · Right 0.

item.title: Russia Accused of Pressuring Scientist's Family Amid Plague Concerns
item.description: Russia has been accused of pressuring the family of a deceased plague scientist to remain silent, according to reports. Concerns are also rising regarding a suspected case of pneumonic plague in Russia. The scientist reportedly died from… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: French Navy Boards Suspected Russian Shadow Fleet Tanker
item.description: The French navy boarded a tanker suspected of being part of Russia's "shadow fleet" in the Indian Ocean. The operation involved boarding the vessel, which was allegedly involved in illicit oil transfers. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: SpaceX Agrees to Testify on AI Safety After NYC Council Subpoena
item.description: SpaceX has agreed to testify before the New York City Council regarding AI safety concerns, following the issuance of a subpoena. The council had sought testimony from the company on the matter. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: MI5 Chief Warns of AI-Enabled Terror Attacks and Russian Election Interference
item.description: The head of Britain's domestic security service, MI5, has issued warnings regarding two distinct threats. He cautioned that artificial intelligence will likely make it easier to launch terror attacks on the UK. Separately, he addressed… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Second Man Jailed for Sycamore Gap Tree Felling Released Early
item.description: A second man, who was jailed for his role in felling the Sycamore Gap tree, has been released from prison. The tree, a well-known landmark, was cut down in September 2023. One report indicates he was released early from his sentence. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: UK Sanctions Iranians Over Airbase Plot; Canada Joins Denunciation
item.description: The United Kingdom has blamed Iran for a plot targeting an airbase and has sanctioned two Iranian nationals in response. Canada has signed a joint statement denouncing Iran following the UK's announcement. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Professor Sacked After Dispute Over Mice Experiment and Urination Allegations
item.description: A professor has been sacked following a dispute that involved the use of women's cells in a mice experiment without consent, and allegations of being a "phantom urinator." The professor lost a legal case related to the sacking. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Boys Arrested After Sydney Bottle Shop Rampage
item.description: Several boys have been arrested following a rampage at a bottle shop in Sydney. The exact number of individuals arrested and the extent of the damage were not specified in the coverage. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Zelenskyy Claims Partners Failed to Warn of Kyiv Missile Strike
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy stated that Ukraine did not receive advance warning from its partners regarding a Russian ballistic missile strike on Kyiv. The attack resulted in five missiles hitting civilian infrastructure… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Roller Coasters Closed After Fatal Incident in Georgia
item.description: Two roller coasters at Canada's Wonderland and one at La Ronde were temporarily closed as a precaution following a fatal incident involving a similar ride in Georgia. The closures were implemented to ensure guest safety. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: US, Japan Review Troop Conduct Rules After Okinawa Killing
item.description: Japanese and U.S. officials are reviewing the off-base code of conduct for U.S. troops stationed in Japan. The review follows the alleged killing of an Okinawan woman by a U.S. Marine. Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi stated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Germany Scrambles Jets Amid Nuremberg Airport Aviation Emergency
item.description: Germany's Nuremberg Airport experienced a temporary closure due to an aviation emergency, prompting the scrambling of fighter jets to escort a flight originating from Corfu. The airport has since reopened. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Debate on Capital Punishment and Firing Squads
item.description: Coverage discusses the concept of firing squads as a method of capital punishment, with one outlet framing it as a potential policy consideration. The topic is presented in the context of global discussions on punishment, referencing a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: MI5 Chief Warns Iran Expanding UK Target Scope to Military Sites
item.description: Britain's domestic security service, MI5, has warned that Iran is expanding its targeting of UK military sites, a shift described as "not unique" by MI5 Chief Ken McCallum. McCallum stated in an annual speech that Tehran's "ambitions" have… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: BJP Women MPs Demand Congress MP's Suspension Over JNU Row
item.description: Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) women Members of Parliament met with President Droupadi Murmu to demand the suspension of Congress MP Bimol Akoijam from the Lok Sabha. The demand is reportedly linked to a Jawaharlal Nehru University (JNU)… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Bike Collisions Result in One Death, Several Injured
item.description: A road accident occurred in Kawardha where two motorcycles collided, resulting in one fatality. In a separate incident in Katni, two bikes collided while en route to a temple, killing one young man and critically injuring five others… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Rs 2.71 Crore Hydroponic Weed Seized at Hyderabad Airport
item.description: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) seized hydroponic weed valued at Rs 2.71 crore at Hyderabad airport. The seizure involved cannabis grown using hydroponic methods. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Dalit Woman Allegedly Assaulted Over Well Water in Ranchi; Five Booked
item.description: A Dalit woman was allegedly assaulted and prevented from fetching water from a well in Ranchi. Five individuals have been booked in connection with the incident. The New Indian Express reported that the assault occurred over access to the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: BJP MPs petition President over sexual harassment allegations against Congress MP
item.description: A group of Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) women Members of Parliament met with President Droupadi Murmu to request the suspension of Congress MP Bimol Akoijam. The petition concerns allegations of sexual harassment against Akoijam. The BJP… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Terrorist hideout busted in Poonch, arms recovered
item.description: Security forces in Jammu and Kashmir's Poonch district have busted a suspected terrorist hideout. Arms and ammunition, including an AK-47 rifle and hand grenades, were recovered from a cave during the operation. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Man Smashes Car Windows Outside Chhattisgarh Chief Minister's Residence
item.description: A man caused a disturbance outside the Chhattisgarh Chief Minister's residence in Raipur, breaking the windows of several vehicles. The individual clashed with police before being taken into custody. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Files Multiple FIRs Over Social Media Misinformation
item.description: Delhi Police has filed over four First Information Reports (FIRs) concerning alleged misinformation spread by social media handles. The FIRs were registered following a protest by the INDIA Bloc in Central Delhi, where police cited… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Houthis Used AI to Develop Ballistic Missiles, Anthropic Claims
item.description: The Houthi group reportedly used Anthropic's AI, specifically the Claude model, to develop ballistic missiles. Anthropic stated that the Houthis used their AI technology to develop missiles and subsequently test-fired a rocket. The… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ED registers money laundering case against Punjab CM's OSD
item.description: The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has registered a money laundering case against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, Officer on Special Duty (OSD) to the Punjab Chief Minister. This action follows a Supreme Court order and is part of a broader corruption… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Lawyer Cites 'Undeclared Emergency' Amidst Mass Detentions; BJP Responds
item.description: Senior Advocate Menaka Guruswamy raised concerns about potential mass detentions, questioning if the country is experiencing an 'undeclared emergency' and reminding the Supreme Court of its role. The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) responded… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Delhi Police Files FIRs Amidst Manipur Violence Probe
item.description: The Delhi Police has registered four First Information Reports (FIRs) in connection with the ongoing violence in Manipur. Investigations are focusing on individuals spreading rumors and social media accounts, including those from Pakistan… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court to Hear Trump Admin's Plea on Withholding DOGE Records
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea from the Trump administration seeking to withhold internal documents related to Dogecoin (DOGE). The administration's request concerns records that could potentially be linked to Elon Musk. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Supreme Court stays defamation proceedings against Rahul Gandhi
item.description: The Supreme Court has granted significant relief to Rahul Gandhi by staying defamation proceedings against him in a case where he had allegedly referred to Prime Minister Narendra Modi as 'Commander-in-thief'. The court's order comes… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Arms and ammunition found in Poonch militant hideout
item.description: Security forces discovered a militant hideout in the Sawjian sector of Poonch, Jammu and Kashmir, recovering arms and ammunition. The recovered items include an AK-47 rifle and six hand grenades. An investigation into the matter is… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Chhattisgarh Minister's WhatsApp Hacked, Fraudulent Payment Requests Made
item.description: The WhatsApp account of Chhattisgarh Minister Laxmi Rajwade was hacked. The hacker sent messages from the minister's account requesting money, with one message stating "UPI is blocked, send 32 thousand rupees online." Another message… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: IIT Bombay Student Allegedly Sought Second Chance Before Suicide
item.description: Following the death of IIT Bombay student Sahil Wakode, Mumbai Police have recorded statements from nearly 40 individuals, including IIT Bombay director Shireesh Kedare. Sources indicate that before his death, Wakode had apologized for… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Maldivian Pilots Detained in UAE Over Alleged Hijacking Plot
item.description: Two Maldivian pilots have been detained in the United Arab Emirates in connection with an alleged plot to down a flydubai aircraft. The flight, FZ1073, was en route from Dubai to Tel Aviv with 174 passengers and crew when the alleged… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Journalist Files Contempt Plea Against Delhi Police, MHA
item.description: A journalist has filed a contempt petition in the Supreme Court against the Union Home Ministry Secretary and the Delhi Police Commissioner. The petition alleges that the Delhi Police has acted in contempt of court. The Free Speech… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Supreme Court to hear plea challenging immunity for Election Commissioners
item.description: The Supreme Court has agreed to hear a plea challenging the lifelong immunity granted to the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) and other Election Commissioners. The court issued a notice to the Union government and the Election Commission… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Education Ministry Forms Panel to Investigate IIIT Ranchi Student Death
item.description: The Union Ministry of Education has formed a three-member committee to investigate the death of a student at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) in Ranchi, Jharkhand. The ministry has taken cognizance of the incident and… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 3.

item.title: Kochi Mini Cooper Crash Kills Three Students, Sparks Outrage
item.description: A Mini Cooper car crashed in Kochi, killing three students. The incident led to outrage after reports emerged that the driver, described as a "VIP brat," allegedly told people at the scene that his father would "handle it." The FIR… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: FIRs Filed After Opposition March Demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's Resignation
item.description: Two First Information Reports (FIRs) were registered following an opposition march in New Delhi on October 10, which demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar. The march was part of a protest against the… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Killer of Molly Ticehurst Plans Appeal Against 28-Year Sentence
item.description: The killer of Molly Ticehurst is planning to appeal his 28-year sentence. Ticehurst's father has expressed dismay at the prospect of an appeal, stating "He's got a hide." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.
